data.name: 记忆迷宫 Memory Maze
data.detailed_description:
*Memory Maze* is a pixel-art puzzle game developed independently by solo developer "Liu Dao Bu Dao" using the Godot Engine; it was officially completed in March 2026. Breaking away from the homogenized design tropes of traditional maze games currently on the market, this title centers on an original "dynamic light and shadow occlusion" system combined with a core gameplay loop driven purely by memory. Utilizing a low-budget, minimalist art style, it crafts a puzzle-solving atmosphere brimming with a sense of the unknown and deep immersion. The game features no complex controls, no mandatory payments, and no intrusive advertisements, focusing instead on a pure, cerebral, and casual gaming experience suitable for players of all ages.

🌟 **Core Gameplay: Say Goodbye to Full Map Visibility—Break Through the Maze Using Only Your Memory**

The game's most defining feature is its complete rejection of traditional maze game conventions—such as full-map visibility or mini-map hints—in favor of an exclusive dynamic light and shadow occlusion mechanism. Players control a small protagonist figure who must explore the environment relying solely on a limited light source held in hand. Areas lying beyond the reach of this light source remain shrouded in total darkness; walls completely block the light, leaving behind no outlines or vague visual cues, thereby maximizing the maze's sense of mystery and the thrill of exploration.

Under this mechanism, players cannot "cheat" their way through levels by relying on visual cues alone. Instead, they must maintain constant focus, utilizing their own memory to precisely record every path taken, the orientation of every fork in the road, and the location of every dead end. Simultaneously, players must dodge randomly appearing traps and search for hidden clues, gradually feeling their way toward the optimal route until they successfully reach the maze's exit to clear the stage. The gameplay emphasizes testing concentration and memory; with its relaxed rather than tense pacing, it serves equally well as a casual, relaxing pastime or as a brain-teasing challenge for dedicated puzzle enthusiasts.

🎮 **Minimalist PC Controls: Zero Barrier to Entry**

The game has been optimized for a lightweight, streamlined experience on PC. Its control logic is extremely minimalist, requiring no complex key combinations, allowing even complete beginners to pick it up instantly: Use the WASD keys or the Arrow keys to move the character forward, backward, left, and right, while using mouse clicks to perform all interactive actions—such as using items or triggering mechanisms. 🧩 Comprehensive Item, Mechanism, and Shop Systems: Enriching the Level-Clearing Experience

To diversify gameplay and lower the barrier to entry for newcomers, the game features a fully integrated system for item collection, interactive mechanisms, and shop-based exchanges using in-game currency. All items can be redeemed entirely for free using in-game coins, with absolutely no additional real-money purchases required. Specific details are as follows:

✅ **Randomly Spawning Maze Items** 1. **Coins:** Scattered randomly throughout the maze; collecting them yields 1–5 coins per pickup. These serve as the sole currency for redeeming items in the shop. 2. **Hand Grenade:** Detonates a specific section of the maze wall, forcibly carving out a new path and allowing players to quickly bypass complex dead ends. 3. **Firearm:** Allows players to shoot at "Ghost" obstacles within the maze, instantly breaking their pursuit and enabling smooth progress along the intended route. 4. **Time Extender:** Immediately adds 30 seconds to the timer for the current level upon activation, helping to alleviate time-related pressure. 5. **Standard Map Book:** Temporarily reveals the complete layout of the current maze upon use, allowing players to quickly grasp the overall structure and orient themselves. 6. **Advanced Map Book:** An advanced utility item that not only reveals the full maze layout but also directly highlights the correct path to complete the level—making it an essential tool for helping beginners clear stages quickly.

✅ **Interactive Scene Mechanisms** 1. **Ghosts:** Minor obstacles that appear randomly throughout the maze. They will automatically begin tracking the player when approached; however, players can easily shake them off by simply running away quickly. These ghosts inflict no damage and serve only to add a mild sense of urgency to the level-clearing process. 2. **Campfires:** A core interactive mechanism within the environment. Players can manually light a campfire when standing nearby, significantly expanding the illuminated area. This temporarily lifts visibility restrictions, making it easier to quickly survey surrounding paths and intersections.

✅ **Coin Shop Redemption Pricing:** Coins collected by the player within the maze can be freely redeemed for items at either the in-level shop or the main menu shop. The pricing for all items is clear and transparent: Hand Grenade (20 coins each), Firearm (30 coins each), Time Extender (50 coins each), Standard Map Book (70 coins each), and Advanced Map Book (90 coins each). 🎨 **Minimalist Pixel Art: Crafting a Highly Immersive Atmosphere on a Budget**

The game employs a visual style that blends pixel art with minimalist hand-drawn aesthetics, prioritizing a design philosophy focused on creating a high-impact atmosphere with minimal resources. The overall color palette is dominated by deep grays and pure blacks, while core light sources utilize warm yellow and cool white highlights to create a stark contrast between light and shadow—perfectly complementing the core gameplay mechanic of dynamic light and shadow occlusion. Environmental details have been meticulously polished; walls feature rough stone and wood textures, while the ground is subtly accented with small elements such as scattered pebbles and weeds. Areas lying outside the player's field of view remain pure black, devoid of any outlines or contours. Though lacking flashy visual effects, this approach successfully conjures an intensely immersive labyrinthine atmosphere, allowing players to focus their full attention on the puzzles themselves.
